configure_shadow_map_world_size: configure the PyBullet debug visualizer shadow map world size to 5 units
configure_shadow_map_resolution: configure the PyBullet debug visualizer shadow map resolution to 8192 pixels
configure_light_position: configure the PyBullet debug visualizer light position using a circular orbit path
connect_gui_and_load_urdf: connect PyBullet in GUI mode and load R2D2 and plane URDF models
step_simulation_loop: run a PyBullet simulation loop that steps physics and updates light position each frame
